summary: The reader is an undergraduate computer scientist: comfortable with asymptotic notation, recurrences and divide-and-conquer, binary and two's-complement arithmetic, integer division with remainder, modular arithmetic, primes and coprimality, sets, bijections and functions, basic vector and matrix algebra, polynomials and complex numbers (including roots of unity), and basic multitape Turing machines with linear scans. The reader has seen schoolbook and Karatsuba multiplication and probably an introductory FFT in an algorithms course, but has not studied abstract algebra (rings, groups, tensor products), finite fields beyond bit arithmetic, numerical analysis of rounding, or the specialist theory of fast integer multiplication, so the wiki must explain those.

known.name: Logarithms, floors and ceilings
known.gloss: The base-2 logarithm and the floor and ceiling functions that round a real number down or up to an integer, used to count the bits of a number.

known.name: Binary representation and integer arithmetic
known.gloss: Writing a nonnegative integer as a bit string or as digits in a radix, with addition, subtraction and schoolbook multiplication on digits and carries.

known.name: Division with remainder
known.gloss: For integers a and b>0 there are unique q=⌊a/b⌋ and r=a−bq with 0≤r<b.

known.name: Modular arithmetic
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers up to equality of remainders modulo a fixed modulus, including addition, multiplication and wraparound.

known.name: Primes, divisibility and coprimality
known.gloss: Prime numbers, divisibility, and integers sharing no common factor (gcd 1), including that a unit modulo a prime power is a number not divisible by the prime.

known.name: Sets, functions and permutations
known.gloss: Finite sets, subsets with intersection and size, functions, and permutations as bijections of a finite set, and products of index sets.

known.name: Matrices and linear maps
known.gloss: Vectors as columns of numbers, matrices acting on them by multiplication and composing by matrix product, with identity, inverse and permutation matrices.

known.name: XOR and arithmetic over F₂
known.gloss: Addition of bits modulo 2 (bitwise XOR), with parity and the number of one bits in a string.

known.name: Asymptotic notation beyond big-O
known.gloss: Tight and lower bounds Θ and Ω, little-o, and absorbing polylogarithmic factors and smaller powers of a growing parameter into a larger one.

known.name: Recurrences and divide and conquer
known.gloss: Bounding the cost of a recursive algorithm by solving a recurrence over subproblem sizes, including unrolling it and summing a geometric series.

known.name: Schoolbook and Karatsuba multiplication
known.gloss: The O(n²) digit-by-digit algorithm for multiplying n-bit integers and the divide-and-conquer improvement with three half-size products.

known.name: Fast Fourier transform as an algorithm
known.gloss: The O(N log N) divide-and-conquer evaluation of a polynomial at N-th roots of unity and its use to multiply polynomials by pointwise products and an inverse transform.

known.name: Inequalities for error bounds
known.gloss: Bounding a sum or product of approximations by adding or multiplying the individual absolute errors, and the idea that rounding to the nearest integer succeeds if the error is below 1/2.

known.name: Lexicographic order and mixed-radix indices
known.gloss: Storing a multi-dimensional array in a linear sequence by ordering index tuples lexicographically, so the position is a mixed-radix number.

known.name: Two's-complement and truncation
known.gloss: Representing signed integers in two's complement and discarding low-order bits to round a number toward zero.
